## Outcome
Deliver realistic, production-ready KanbanBoard v4.0: V0.0.0 SemVer & n-1 tracking (kb_version.py), containerized TELL/SHOW doc store & 120d feedback retention (kb_doc_store.py), sterilized agy/codex CLI runner with smart stream extraction (kb_doc_runner.py), strict-CSP doc_shared/ & v4_nav Web App views (including /api/doc/show.js & expandable Cases), and full MCP kanban_project + non-QA version_nudge integration.


## Scope
kb_version.py, kb_doc_store.py, kb_doc_runner.py, doc_shared/*, resources/v4_nav.*, resources/board.html, viewer.py, mcp_server.py, package.py, plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/kanban/SKILL.md, skills/kanban-doc/SKILL.md, scripts/wire_v4.py, tests/test_qa_lock.py, tests/test_v4_version_doc_and_runner.py


## Plan (Todo Tree)
- [ ] A1 [START] Copy v4.0 modules, doc_shared runtime, skills/kanban-doc, wire_v4.py, and test suite, then smooth kb_doc_runner.py and wire_v4.py for Windows shims, agy stream extraction, strict-CSP script/style compliance, and /api/doc/show.js route
- [ ] A2 [after:A1] Make doc_shared/shell.js, doc_shared/base.css, resources/v4_nav.js, and resources/v4_nav.css 100% strict-CSP clean, fix /api/board?summary=1 project slug discovery, add Case detail inspection, and update viewer.py board_stamp & package.py bundling
- [ ] A3 [after:A2] Wire kanban_project tool (bump_version, version_history, doc_config) and non-QA version_nudge surfacing into mcp_server.py, bump manifests to 4.0.0, run wire_v4.py --apply, and add integration tests
- [ ] T1 [after:A3] [ACCEPTANCE:MANDATORY] Rebuild dist/kanbanBoard.plugin, sync plugin lock & Gemini/Claude files, and run full test suite + pre_commit_verify_done.py + board lint


## Prove
$env:KANBAN_TEST_AUTO_CONFIRM="1"; python -m unittest discover -s tests -p "test_*.py" -v; python C:\Projects\kanbanBoard\scripts\pre_commit_verify_done.py

note: v4.0 implementation & smoothing complete (81/81 unit tests pass, verify-done OK, board lint clean). Ready for kb-qa audit.
